description: This file contains utility functions for error handling and serialization, including safe stringification of objects, extraction of error details, and error message formatting, specifically tailored for handling errors in a WhatsApp extension context.

methods.name: safeStringify
methods.description: Serializes a value to JSON with handling for bigints, functions, circular references, and length limiting.

methods.name: extractBoomDetails
methods.description: Extracts error details such as status code, error message, and message from an error object, especially handling Boom error objects.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Retrieves the status code from an error object, checking multiple possible properties.

methods.name: formatError
methods.description: Formats an error object into a human-readable string, extracting details from various error formats.
